actual_result: Read-only cross-check of ParentCallerCP1 v2 against CP2 v3: compatible. CP1 v2 pins the four v3 union version fields exactly, with the same semantics as CP2 v3 (str type, exact equality, absence refuses) and before any union status use. CP1's three unchecked items assessed from the CP2 side: none is a CP2 safety gap; union.item recommended as a cheap later check.
blocker: None. Review, finite qualification and all runtime/release remain parent-owned.

cp1_unchecked_items_cp2_view.endedness_module: Not a safety gap among CP2 versions. evaluate_endedness predicates are unchanged v1->v3 apart from the version gate CP1 v2 already applies to the union. A v1/v2 evaluate_endedness loaded as a separate module rejects a v3 CensusLog (type(log) is CensusLog) -> E_NO_SERVED_CENSUS, fail-closed; with its own old CensusLog the census logic is identical. A non-CP2 callable is forgery, which no self-reported field detects (prerequisite identity_union_census_cp2).
cp1_unchecked_items_cp2_view.fresh_log: Not a safety requirement. CP2 evaluate_endedness evaluates every served snapshot conjunctively, so earlier snapshots can only add HELD causes; the MAX_SERVED 16 census refusal is fail-closed; the effect is availability only.
cp1_unchecked_items_cp2_view.union_item: MINOR recommendation for a later CP1 successor, overlapping CP2 SR-5: the union's top-level item is the CP2 request item, which CP2 binds to the parent wait and launch record items; union.item == spec.item is a cheap consistency check. Indirect binding already exists: spec.identities typed-equal union.prt_identities carry the driver/oracle sv19 start fingerprints that PRT binds to spec.exit and spec.oracle wait records.

cross_check.report_compatibility: v3 _union_report emits all four fields; v3 _minimal_report lacks design_freeze_sha256/producer_sha256, so CP1 v2 gives CP1_UNION_VERSION (still HELD). No union field names or formats changed v1->v3.
cross_check.semantics: CP1 v2 _union_version (705-716): type str and exact equality, absence refuses; called in _union (720-725) immediately after _detach and before state/prt_identities use, firing CP1_UNION_VERSION and never invoking PRT3. Same predicate as CP2 v3 _union_version.
